text:
Pat L: hey folks — first day! quick access issue: I can log into Console but when I try to open the staging Admin > Feature Flags panel I get a 403. I need to toggle a flag for a smoke test.
Devon (infra): welcome Pat :wave: — can you paste the exact error or screenshot? are you using SSO or the service account?
Pat L: using SSO (Google SAML). error snippet from browser console: "GET /api/admin/flags 403 Forbidden". No UI controls show up, just a banner.
Sam (platform): @Pat L, check that you were added to the "console-admins-staging" group. People-ops usually adds you during onboarding but sometimes the group mapping misses.
Pat L: how do I check that?
Devon (infra): you can run this (if you have CLI access):
```bash
# list groups for your user (internal tool)
redwood-iam whoami --email pat.l@redwood.com --list-groups
```
if that shows console-admins-staging, you should be fine. otherwise we can patch it.
Pat L: I don't have the redwood-iam CLI set up yet.
Jess (people-ops): I can confirm your join request — I see you in the org, but the staging admin group is missing. filing a quick add now.
infra-bot: created request #INC-7923 to add Pat L to console-admins-staging; ETA ~ 20m.
Devon (infra): in the meantime if you need to flip a flag for the smoke test, we can create a temporary feature-flag-ops token for you. Sam, can you generate a short-lived token?
Sam (platform): can do. Pat, what scope do you need? read/write on /admin/flags in staging?
Pat L: read/write on that panel only for a single flag (team-ff/enable-experimental-encoder).
Sam (platform): ok generating 30m token...
infra-bot: token created: TOKEN_REDACTED_**** (expires in 30 minutes). Use it in the Console dev toolbar: Settings > Use token.
Pat L: tried the token, UI toggles worked — thanks! :tada: Jess, let me know when the group add completes so I can use my SSO account instead.
Jess (people-ops): group add finished, should propagate in ~2m. If you still see 403 after 5m, ping me and I'll escalate to identity.
Devon (infra): note for docs: onboarding checklist missing explicit step for verifying console group membership. filing a short doc issue.
Sam (platform): added a short note to the new-hires runbook: "verify console-admins-staging membership" with the CLI snippet.
Pat L: awesome, thanks everyone. super smooth help. one last question — where are the feature flag audit logs for staging? need to include in my PR notes.
Devon (infra): Admin > Audit Logs > filter->resource: feature-flags, env: staging. or via API: `GET /api/admin/audit?resource=feature-flag&env=staging` (requires admin scope).
Pat L: perfect. closing this thread after I confirm the group propagate. :white_check_mark:
